stock_name: E TO E TRANS INFRA LTD
headline: E To E Transportation wins Rs 37.77 crore Southern Railway order
summary: E To E Transportation Infrastructure secured a Rs 37.77 crore order from Southern Railway for signaling works at Podanur Junction. This adds to recent wins from Adani Power and other railway divisions.

headline: United Spirits completes ₹2.69 crore Nuvola Spirits investment
summary: United Spirits Ltd has completed its ₹2.69 crore investment in craft beverage startup Nuvola Spirits Private Limited. The deal secures a 10.08% stake via CCPS and equity, aligning with the company's strategy to back innovative brands in the premium segment.

headline: Current Infraprojects wins Rs 10.42 cr order from BNP Dewas
summary: Current Infraprojects secures Rs 10.42 crore work order from Bank Note Press for a 3 MW solar project. This is the first disclosed order in recent quarters, marking a new revenue stream.

headline: Envirotech Systems wins Rs 2.93 crore order from Gainwell
summary: Envirotech Systems wins Rs 2.93 crore work order from Gainwell Commosales for DG set acoustic enclosures. Total disclosed order book stands at Rs 4.85 crore across two clients in the last three quarters.

headline: NCLT approves MPS Ltd, ADI BPO merger scheme
summary: The NCLT Chennai bench has approved the second motion for the amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited into MPS Limited. The tribunal recorded shareholder and creditor approvals and directed statutory notices.

headline: NTPC Green Energy unit launches 68.22 MW solar phase
summary: A subsidiary of NTPC Green Energy commissioned the third phase of the 200 MW Dahod Solar Project at 68.22 MW, raising total capacity to 10,911 MW.

headline: CRISIL reaffirms GIC Housing Finance AA+ rating
summary: CRISIL has maintained its AA+ Stable rating on the long-term facilities and NCDs of GIC Housing Finance, along with an A1+ rating for its short-term facilities and commercial paper.

headline: Ramco Cements' Hard Worker wins 3 design awards
summary: Ramco Cements' construction chemicals brand Hard Worker secured three honours at the Kyoorius Design Awards 2026, including the Grand Prix. The brand crossed ₹350 crore in sales within its first year.

headline: Goldiam receives ₹23.55 Cr BMC tax notice
summary: Goldiam International has received a property tax demand of ₹23.55 crore from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation covering the period from April 2010 to March 2026.

headline: Mehul Telecom opens new retail store in Gujarat
summary: Mehul Telecom Limited has expanded its retail footprint with a new franchise store in Khambhalia, Gujarat. The outlet opened on September 19, 2026, marking a step in the company's distribution network growth.

headline: Tirupati Forge gets license to make artillery shells
summary: Tirupati Forge has received an industrial license to manufacture artillery shells up to 155MM, with pilot production scheduled to begin in December 2026.

headline: Unichem Labs wins GST appeal, avoids ₹87 cr penalty
summary: Unichem Laboratories receives order disallowing ₹87.07 crore GST penalty and ₹6.58 crore interest. Company plans to file further appeal against the Commissioner's decision.

headline: SBI to host virtual investor meet on Sep 25
summary: State Bank of India will hold a virtual interaction with institutional investors on September 25, 2026, organized by Citi. The session is scheduled from 2:00 pm to 3:00 pm.

headline: Fedders Holding subsidiary completes Noida project
summary: Fedders Holding Ltd announced its subsidiary Fedders Electric and Engineering Limited has completed a premium commercial real estate project in Noida. The 3,00,000 sq ft facility is ready for leasing.

headline: Nikki Global Finance AGM: Financials adopted
summary: Nikki Global Finance Ltd held its 40th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 audited financial statements and reappointed director Rahul Bahukhandi.

headline: Astonea Labs clarifies FY25 filing gaps
summary: Astonea Labs Limited addresses BSE queries regarding missing PDF and declaration files for its FY25 standalone results. The company submitted the requisite documents to ensure regulatory compliance.

headline: Yes Bank concludes Jefferies 5 India Forum analyst meet
summary: Yes Bank Limited disclosed the outcome of its Jefferies 5th India Forum analyst meet held on September 18, 2026. The bank met with several institutional investors in Gurgaon, confirming no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared.

headline: KM Sugar Mills sets Oct 1 as demerger effective date
summary: KM Sugar Mills Ltd has fixed October 1, 2026, as the effective date for its distillery division demerger. Shareholders holding five shares will receive one share in the new entity.

headline: Mahasagar Travels holds 33rd AGM, reappoints director
summary: Mahasagar Travels Limited concluded its 33rd AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 standalone financials and reappointed Ms. Kavita A. Bachani as a director.

headline: Radhe Developers holds 32nd AGM, adopts FY26 accounts
summary: Radhe Developers (India) Limited concluded its 32nd Annual General Meeting on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, and re-appointed director Alok Vaidya.

headline: ASK Automotive to host analyst meet on Sep 28
summary: ASK Automotive Limited will participate in the Nuvama Emerging India CEO Forum in Mumbai on September 28, 2026. The management will discuss publicly available information with institutional investors.

headline: Asia Capital Ltd concludes 42nd AGM
summary: Asia Capital Limited held its 42nd Annual General Meeting on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved financial statements and director appointments.

headline: AIA Engineering schedules plant visits for investors
summary: AIA Engineering has scheduled plant visits for analysts and institutional investors on September 24, 2026, organized by J. P. Morgan. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information will be discussed during the event.

headline: Zeal Aqua board approves ₹249.96 Cr credit facility
summary: Zeal Aqua Limited's board approved an enhanced credit facility of ₹249.96 crore from a PNB-led consortium on September 18, 2026. The increase from the existing ₹206.00 crore limit supports working capital and term loan requirements.

headline: Noida Toll Bridge to pay second interim distribution
summary: Noida Toll Bridge Company Ltd schedules board meeting on September 23, 2026, to approve the second interim distribution to financial creditors.

headline: Vivid Mercantile appoints Brickwork Ratings for rights issue
summary: Vivid Mercantile Ltd board approved Brickwork Ratings India Pvt. Ltd as monitoring agency for its proposed equity rights issue proceeds on September 19, 2026.

headline: Gujjubhai Industries sets AGM record date
summary: Gujjubhai Industries Limited has fixed September 23, 2026 as the record date for its 37th Annual General Meeting. The register of members will remain closed from September 24 to 30, 2026.

headline: J&K Bank appoints four new statutory auditors for FY27
summary: Jammu & Kashmir Bank has appointed four firms as statutory central auditors for FY27, replacing two outgoing auditors. The appointments were made by the C&AG of India on September 18, 2026.

headline: Puravankara launches Provident Equinox Phase 6
summary: Puravankara Limited's subsidiary Provident Housing launched Phase 6 of the Provident Equinox residential project in Bengaluru on September 20, 2026. The development is registered with RERA under PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/180926/008948.

headline: Tashi India AGM: Directors Reappointed
summary: Tashi India Limited held its 41st AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 financials and reappointed Rohit Bajaj. Two new independent directors were also appointed.

headline: Godawari Power declares Re.1 dividend at AGM
summary: Godawari Power & Ispat Ltd held its AGM on September 19, 2026, declaring a final dividend of Re.1 per share for FY26 and reappointing key directors.

headline: Tulsyan NEC holds 79th AGM, reappoints director
summary: Tulsyan NEC Limited concluded its 79th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of FY26 financials and the reappointment of Executive Chairman Lalit Kumar Tulsyan.

headline: Kings Infra: Promoter shares transmitted to legal heir
summary: Kings Infra Ventures Ltd disclosed the transmission of 1,11,300 promoter shares from late C Baby John to his legal heir Annamma Baby John. The transfer involves no change in overall promoter group control.

headline: Telge Projects promoter relative buys shares
summary: Vishal Uttam Telge, immediate relative of a promoter at Telge Projects Ltd, purchased 4,800 equity shares worth ₹10,09,272 on the BSE. His holding rose to 14,407 shares.

headline: Electrosteel acquires 70% stake in Oman water tech firm
summary: Electrosteel Castings completes acquisition of 70% stake in Arabian Water Tech LLC for OMR 21,000. The Dubai-based entity becomes a subsidiary, marking the company's expansion into the Middle East water technology sector.

headline: Chemkart India holds 7th AGM, appoints auditors
summary: Chemkart India Limited held its 7th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of financial statements for FY26 and the appointment of statutory and secretarial auditors.

headline: Steelcast schedules investor meets in Mumbai
summary: Steelcast Ltd will host one-on-one and group meetings with investors and analysts in Mumbai on September 23 and 24, 2026, to discuss publicly available information.

headline: Highness Microelectronics wins display award
summary: Highness Microelectronics Limited has been honoured with the 'Display Rising Star Award' at the India Display Conference 2026, recognising its progress in vertically integrating display module manufacturing.

headline: Godrej Properties builds road linking Sector 49 to SPR
summary: Godrej Properties has constructed a 24-metre-wide road connecting Sector 49 to the Southern Peripheral Road in Gurugram, improving connectivity in the area.

headline: Prism Medico AGM approves Infuze Well investment
summary: Prism Medico & Pharmacy Ltd shareholders approved the strategic investment in Infuze Well Private Limited and re-appointed director Davender Singh at its 24th AGM held on September 19, 2026.

headline: Railtel wins GST appeal, ₹49.24 Lakh demand dropped
summary: Railtel Corporation of India Ltd has secured a regulatory win as the Additional Commissioner of Appeals set aside a ₹49.24 Lakh GST demand notice. The order removes any financial liability for the company.

headline: K&R Rail Engineering gets ROC nod for AGM extension
summary: K&R Rail Engineering Ltd has received approval from the Registrar of Companies for a three-month extension to hold its Annual General Meeting for FY26. The AGM, originally due by September 30, 2026, can now be convened within the extended timeline.

headline: GIPCL holds 41st AGM, adopts FY26 financials
summary: Gujarat Industries Power Co Ltd concluded its 41st AGM on September 19, 2026. Members adopted the audited financial statements for FY26 and approved dividend declaration. One director reappointment was dropped.

headline: J&K Bank MD to speak at Nuvama CEO conference
summary: Jammu and Kashmir Bank's MD and management team will participate in the Emerging India CEO Conference on September 28, 2026. The session will rely solely on publicly available documents.

headline: Piramal Finance shareholders approve ₹1,750 crore warrant issue
summary: Piramal Finance Ltd shareholders approved a special resolution to raise up to ₹1,750.03 crore via warrants convertible into equity shares through a preferential issue to promoter group entity Nithyam Realty Private Limited.

headline: GIPCL Independent Director Misra Steps Down
summary: Narendra Nath Misra ceased to be an independent director at Gujarat Industries Power Company Ltd on September 19, 2026, after completing his second five-year term.

headline: ITI Ltd gets 3-month AGM extension
summary: Registrar of Companies grants ITI Limited a three-month extension to hold its 76th AGM for FY26, citing reasons stated in the application filed under Section 96 of the Companies Act.

headline: Jaiprakash Power settles IBC claim with NARCL for ₹511 crore
summary: Jaiprakash Power Ventures has agreed to settle its IBC claim with NARCL for ₹511 crore. The settlement is subject to conditions and execution of definitive agreements.

headline: Goenka Business & Finance approves final dividend for FY26
summary: Goenka Business & Finance Ltd board approved a 5% final dividend of ₹0.50 per share for FY26. The payout awaits shareholder approval at the 39th AGM on September 29, 2026.

headline: Shree Hari Chemicals promoters seek public reclassification
summary: Four promoters of Shree Hari Chemicals Export Ltd have requested reclassification to the public category under SEBI Regulation 31A, citing zero shareholding and no management involvement.

headline: Bharat Parenterals concludes 33rd AGM
summary: Bharat Parenterals Limited concluded its 33rd AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved financials for FY26, declared a final dividend, and reappointed Executive Director Hemang Shah.

headline: Vedanta promoter shares encumbered for bond tap
summary: Vedanta Resources Limited disclosed encumbrance over promoter group shares following a $400 million bond tap issue. The move supports debt repayment under SEBI Regulation 31.

headline: Asian Paints promoter pledges 26.79 lakh shares
summary: Smiti Holding, a promoter of Asian Paints Ltd, pledged 26.79 lakh shares for loans on September 16-17, 2026. The move raises total encumbered stake to 4.03%.

headline: Concord Biotech board to consider bonus issue
summary: Concord Biotech Ltd schedules board meeting for September 23, 2026, to consider a bonus equity share proposal. Trading window remains closed until September 26.

headline: Kalyan Jewellers AGM: Dividend, Board Reappointments
summary: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd held its 18th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved a final dividend of ₹2.50 per share for FY26 and reappointed two directors. The meeting also addressed chairman remuneration.

headline: Western Carriers promoter acquires 1 lakh shares
summary: Rajendra Sethia, promoter and CMD of Western Carriers (India) Ltd, bought 1,00,000 equity shares on September 18, 2026. The acquisition raises his stake to 72.928% of the total paid-up capital.

headline: Vedanta Power promoters encumber shares for bond issue
summary: Vedanta Resources Limited disclosed encumbrance over promoter group shares in Vedanta Power Limited. The move secures $400 million in Tap Bonds issued by its subsidiary, Vedanta Resources Finance II PLC.

headline: MTAR Technologies promoter pledges 32,000 shares
summary: Promoter Kavitha Reddy Gangapatnam pledged 32,000 MTAR Technologies shares with 360 One Distribution Services for loan availing on September 17, 2026.

headline: Refex Industries wins ₹160 crore pond ash contract
summary: Refex Industries secures a ₹160 crore contract for pond ash lifting from a Madhya Pradesh public sector undertaking, marking a significant order win.

headline: Refex Industries bags Rs 160 crore ash order
summary: Refex Industries secures a Rs 160 crore contract from a Madhya Pradesh PSU for pond and fly ash lifting. The deal involves 10 MT monthly lifting over 18 months, boosting the company's order book significantly.

headline: Kalyan Jewellers Infuses ₹350 Cr in Candere
summary: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd has completed a ₹350 crore rights issue in its wholly owned subsidiary, Candere Lifestyle Jewellery Pvt Ltd. The capital infusion is aimed at repaying loans extended by the holding company to the e-commerce jewellery arm.

headline: CSL Finance holds 34th AGM, approves dividend
summary: CSL Finance Limited concluded its 34th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 audited financial statements, declared a dividend, and re-appointed key board members including the Managing Director.

headline: Asian Hotels West promoter acquires 9.51 lakh shares via gift
summary: Sandeep Gupta acquired 9.51 lakh shares of Asian Hotels (West) Ltd from his mother, Vinita Gupta, via gift. His stake rose to 16.32%, while hers fell to 1.72%. The transfer was exempt from open offer obligations.

headline: Chiraharit wins Rs 59.6 lakh order from Govt for irrigation system
summary: Chiraharit secures Rs 59.6 lakh work order from Northern Region Farm Machinery Training & Testing Institute for center pivot irrigation. Order adds to Q2FY27 inflow of Rs 163.52 crore. Book-to-bill data unavailable due to zero TTM revenue.

headline: Panchmahal Steels wins Rs 38.7 crore order from Bhel
summary: Panchmahal Steels secures a confirmed work order worth Rs 38.7 crore from Bhel for SS wire supply. The deal adds to the company's order book, though TTM revenue is currently reported as zero. Execution and revenue recognition will depend on delivery schedules.

headline: Genus Paper promoter group shifts 80.3 lakh shares
summary: Genus Paper & Boards Ltd disclosed an inter-se transfer of 80,38,800 shares within its promoter group between August 18 and September 16, 2026. The total promoter holding remains unchanged at 50.84%.

headline: APTEL allows JSW Energy subsidiary IDC claim
summary: APTEL set aside CERC order, allowing JSW Hydro Energy's interest claim on excess equity. Tribunal remanded matter for prudence check.

headline: Dilesh Roadlines exits Sejal Glass stake
summary: Dilesh Roadlines Pvt Ltd sold 1,00,000 shares (0.8772%) of Sejal Glass Ltd via bulk deal on September 16, 2026, reducing its holding to nil.

headline: Sar Auto Products promoter sells 1195 shares
summary: Promoter Shreyas R Virani sold 1195 equity shares of Sar Auto Products Ltd on Sept 17, 2026 via open market. His stake falls to 27.17%, while the promoter group retains 74.16%.

headline: Ashapura Minechem declares ₹2 dividend
summary: Ashapura Minechem recommends a final dividend of ₹2 per share for FY26. The record date is set for September 22, 2026, pending shareholder approval at the AGM.

headline: GIPCL appoints Dr. Rajender Kumar as additional director
summary: Gujarat Industries Power Company Ltd appointed Dr. Rajender Kumar as an additional director on September 19, 2026. He serves as Managing Director of Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited.

headline: Advit Jewels: Saraogi PAC buys 3.45 lakh shares
summary: Ramesh Sawalram Saraogi and Navratri Share Trading Private Limited acquired 3,45,000 Advit Jewels shares via open market on Sept 18, 2026, raising stake to 5.24%.

headline: Global Surfaces Ltd concludes 35th AGM proceedings
summary: Global Surfaces Limited held its 35th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders adopted FY26 financials and re-appointed key directors. The meeting concluded with no qualifications in auditor reports.

headline: Jindal Stainless promoter group buys 9.9 lakh shares
summary: JSL Overseas Holding, part of the Jindal Stainless promoter group, acquired 9,97,696 shares via open market purchases on September 16 and 17, 2026. The stake rose to 17.40%.

headline: Suvidha Infraestate holds 34th AGM, appoints secretarial auditor
summary: Suvidha Infraestate Corporation held its 34th AGM on September 19, 2026. The meeting approved financials for FY26, reappointed director Kishore Goswami, and appointed a secretarial auditor for five years.

headline: Ruparel Food Products holds 32nd AGM, approves related-party deals
summary: Ruparel Food Products Limited concluded its 32nd AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 financials and reappointed director Pankaj Ruparel. Related-party transactions with two affiliates were also ratified.

headline: Nirmitee Robotics holds 10th AGM, adopts FY26 accounts
summary: Nirmitee Robotics India Limited held its 10th AGM on September 19, 2026. The meeting adopted audited accounts for FY26 and regularized the appointment of Rahul Kartik Shende as a non-executive director.

headline: Healthy Life Agritec to consider rights issue
summary: Healthy Life Agritec schedules board meeting on September 23, 2026, to consider a rights issue. Trading window closes for insiders until 48 hours post-meeting.

headline: KAMA Realty acquires 10 lakh SRF shares
summary: KAMA Realty (Delhi) Limited acquired 10,00,000 equity shares of SRF Limited, representing a 0.34% stake. The off-market inter-se transfer from KAMA Holdings marks the first tranche of a larger proposed deal.

headline: ICICI Pru MF crosses 5% stake in CIE Automotive India
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund acquired 63,542 shares of CIE Automotive India Ltd on September 17, 2026. The open-market purchase pushed its total holding to 5.013%, triggering SEBI takeover regulations disclosure.

headline: KSH International schedules investor meetings
summary: KSH International has announced a schedule of analyst and investor meetings for late September 2026. The engagements include virtual sessions and in-person conferences in Mumbai and Supa.

headline: Accel promoter N R Panicker buys 10,658 shares
summary: Accel Limited promoter N R Panicker acquired 10,658 equity shares via open market between September 4 and 16, 2026. His total holding rose to 40.64%.

headline: Modern Malleables AGM: Key Resolutions Passed
summary: Modern Malleables held its 42nd AGM on September 18, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of financial statements for FY26, re-appointment of a director, and revision of remuneration for the CMD.

headline: SBI MF crosses 5% stake in Tech Mahindra
summary: SBI Mutual Fund acquired 2,54,865 shares of Tech Mahindra on September 17, 2026, pushing its total holding to 5.0134%. The fund filed a disclosure under Regulation 29(1) of SEBI SAST regulations.

headline: Orient Cement CFO Kajal Saxena resigns
summary: Orient Cement Limited has accepted the resignation of Ms. Kajal Saxena as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 18, 2026. She cited career opportunities outside the organization as the reason for her departure.
